motivation_disclosure: A prior fixed-logistic missingness diagnostic was inspected. It showed causal forward-fill preserved that weak reference better than no-fill and train-fit median, but the reference itself had POD=0 at its frozen threshold. This transfer therefore retains ALL THREE prior recovery arms and ALL THREE prior outage fractions; it is not a fresh recovery-method selection experiment.

training.specialist_model: 5-seed XGBoost median ensemble with the exact promoted hyperparameters
training.meta_model: PositiveEvidenceStack fitted only to chronological OOF predictions inside outer fit
training.calibration: single intercept fitted on clean calibration role only

outage.eligible_cells: finite observed causal predictor cells only
outage.causal_forward_fill: uses only earlier real/recoverable values and does not cross a preexisting unavailable barrier as defined by the frozen recovery primitive

evaluation.primary: paired change in TSS at each frozen clean decision policy

bootstrap.unit: complete NEW-crossing SEP episode or quiet block

evaluation.selection_rule: No arm or fraction may be omitted based on outcome. Report all 3x3 combinations.

claim_boundary: Development-only robustness transfer on an already-inspected score block. Cannot establish final superiority, locked-test robustness, operational certification, physics advantage, economic savings, award outcome or breakthrough.
